title: One of the FASTEST AERO BIKES on the Road! *Winspace T1600*

takeaways.text: Size-L 1× Ultegra Di2 build with 50 mm F-Sports wheels, 30 mm tires, power-meter pedals, cages and mount weighed 6.88 kg.

Much stiffer and more responsive than the T1550 under power; the shop-owner presenter finds Quick Pro's ER:ONE slightly more vertically compliant and better value, and Evolve's CIMA more comfortable with a little more bottom-bracket flex.
Rated for 32 mm tires; his 30 mm tires on 24 mm internal rims measured about 31.5 mm and still showed a good gap. The front caliper mounting meant he could run only a 160 mm front rotor.

disclosure: The description links Winspace's T1600 page with the creator's discount code and other discount codes.
summary: Walk-round of the creator's long-used T1600 build with Farsports wheels: seatpost and clamp, dropouts and direct-mount hanger, saddle and parts, and why it is his choice for fast group rides.
